remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x603)
spec2def(rtworkq.dll rtworkq.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

# rtworkq.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/rtworkq-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(rtworkq_shims OBJECT queue.c)
target_link_libraries(rtworkq_shims PRIVATE wine libole32 libcrypt32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libkernel32_vista libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(rtworkq_shims)
add_dependencies(rtworkq_shims psdk)
add_cargo_module(rtworkq rtworkq-cargo rtworkq.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS rtworkq_shims psdk)
